paite: Siampu Lianpen peuhmah khelhnate jiaka thialpiak leh kithoihnate a lat kop theihna ding ua, mihing laka mi lak tuama naomin, Pathian lam thil bangah mihingte adia seh ahi ngal ua:
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

paite: Huaiten tuh bangmah theiloute leh lamhaihte tungah migit a suah thei nak uhi, amau ngei leng hatlouhna a tuama om sam jiakun.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

paite: Huan, huaijiak takin, mite a dinga a latsak bangun, amau ading ngei leng khelhnate jiakin lan sam loutheilou ahi uhi.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

paite: Huan, huai pahtawina tuh kuamah amau akipe ngeikei uh, Aron banga Pathian sap a hih ngal kei uleh.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

paite: Huchibang mahin Kris leng Siampu Lianpena bawldingin amaha kihihthupikei hi, Nang jaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuniin, ka honnei khia, chia, a kianga genpan a hihthupizota hi;
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.” Psalm 2:7

paite: Nang jaw, Melkisedek omdan banga khantawna Siampu na hi, chia, mun danga a gen bangmahin.
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.” Psalm 110:4

paite: Amah tuh, a sa put laini khongin, sihna laka amah hondam theipa kiangah nakpitaka kikou leh khitui ke kawmin thumnate leh ngetnate a lana, a kihtakdan a siam jel jiakin ngaihkhiakin a om hi;
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

paite: Ta hilhial leng hi mahleh a thil thuakahte khawng thuman a zilta ahi.
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

paite: Huchiin, hihhoih kimtaka hongomin, a thumangte peuhmah adingin khantawna hotdamna bulpi ahonghita hi;
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

paite: Melkisedek omdan banga Siampu Lianpenin Pathianin a bawlta hi.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

paite: Huai mi tanchin a hihleh gen ding tampi I nei ua, genchet leng a haksa, na bil uh a nangawntak jiakin.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

paite: A hun ngaihtuahin jaw heutu hi khinta hial le uchin kilawm hiven, Pathian thubulte khawng hilh kiphamoh nawn neive ua, an gum hilou nawitui kiphamoh nong hita ve ua.
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

paite: Nawitui ne peuhmahin diktatna thu ah theihna a nei ngal kei ua, naungek a hih jiak un.An gum bel piching ading ahi, huaiten a zat gige jiak un sia leh pha theichian dingin a theihtheihnate uh tuh a sin zongsangta uhi.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

paite: An gum bel piching ading ahi, huaiten a zat gige jiak un sia leh pha theichian dingin a theihtheihnate uh tuh a sin zongsangta uhi.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
